High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Jitendra Verma - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri H.S.Rathore - Government Advocate for the responde

Heard on I.A.No.14259/2025, first application under Section 430 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (equivalent to Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C.) for suspension of remaining jail sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of the appellant - Munna S/o Thavariya Barela.

The appellant has been convicted for offence under Section 376(2)(N) of IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and sentenced to undergo 10 years R.I. with fine of Rs.2000/- and life imprisonment with fine of Rs.2,000/- with default stipulation.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Counsel for the appellant has argued that the prosecutrix has not supported the prosecution case.
As per prosecution the age of the prosecutrix has been proved to be 17 years 11 months 15 days.
The appellant has already undergone incarceration of period of more than four years.
The appeal is of the year 2022 and final hearing of the appeal is likely to take long time, hence prayed for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.
Counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the prayer by submitting that the FSL report has been found to be positive.

After hearing the counsel for the parties and considering the testimony 2 CRA-10168-2022 of the prosecutrix as she has completely turned hostile and not supported the prosecution case, her age is nearing 18 years as she was 17 years 11 months 15 days and age of the accused was also 20 years at the time of incident, evidence on record, coupled with the fact that final hearing of the appeal is likely to take long time, however without commenting on the merit of the case, we are of the considered opinion that the appellant is entitled for grant of suspension of sentence.

Accordingly, I.A.No.14259/2025 is allowed and it is directed that the execution of remaining jail sentence against the appellant shall remain suspended and he be released on bail upon his depositing the fine amount if not already deposited and upon furnishing bail bond in the sum of Munna vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110083548/
1 Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 06.04.2026 and on subsequent dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry.

entities.text: Munna vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: With the aforesaid, I.A is allowed and disposed of.
